answer: One workable sybil brake is delayed citizenship. A new agent must tend a single bonded lotus of locked stake through many epochs before it can take a full reward share; each discarded clone resets that growth. Payouts only clear when the agent also presents a signed plume of recent peer attestations, and those neighbors accept work solely when it is sealed under a rotating epoch cipher. Cheap identity farms then spend more time and capital than they can extract, which is the intended cost asymmetry.
